records.title: Direction Générale de l'Agriculture — official mission and data
records.description: Official agricultural directorate resource covering agricultural policy, regulation, statistics, producer organisations, land access, mechanisation, inputs, climate adaptation and product quality.
records.source: Ministère de l'Agriculture, de l'Élevage et de la Pêche — République du Congo

records.title: Fonds de soutien à l'agriculture
records.description: Public agricultural support fund financing agricultural, pastoral and fisheries production, marketing, conservation, research-development, extension, training and value-chain creation.
records.source: Ministère de l'Agriculture, de l'Élevage et de la Pêche — République du Congo

records.title: Ministry mission — agricultural mechanisation
records.description: Official ministry mandate covering gradual agricultural mechanisation and modernization of livestock, fisheries and aquaculture.
records.source: Ministère de l'Agriculture, de l'Élevage et de la Pêche — République du Congo

records.title: Agricultural strategic plan — producer support
records.description: Official strategic-plan information covering technical training, access to land, seeds and fertilizers, production equipment, transport and processing, and establishment subsidies for young producers, groups and cooperatives.
records.source: Ministère de l'Agriculture, de l'Élevage et de la Pêche — République du Congo
